How it works.

List. Approve. Sign.

List the unit, take applications and e-sign the lease in the app.

Rent Comes In

Tenants pay by bank straight to your account. Autopay, reminders and late fees run themselves. Your tenant pays the bank payment fee, or you can cover it.

Repairs Go Out

Tenants send requests with photos. You approve, or let NOHM Autopilot handle it.

NOHM Autopilot

Hands off.
Still in charge.

Write a few house notes and NOHM Autopilot takes it from there. It answers tenant messages, books repairs, reviews every estimate and brings you the decisions that are yours to make. Emergencies like fire, gas or water go straight to you, every time. You get an activity log and a summary every week.

NOHM Walkthrough

Move-in and move-out,
on the record.

Do the condition report yourself, room by room with photos, or order a NOHM Walkthrough and a trained local specialist does it for you. Both sides sign it, it locks, and at move-out every room sits beside how it looked on day one. You pay only when the report is in.

Applications on your phone.

Take applications in the app. Applying is free for your applicant.

  1. Send the application from the app.
  2. They fill it in on their phone.
  3. Read it in the app.
  4. Approve or deny.

Background checks are coming soon. They are not on yet.

Know what every unit makes.

Income, costs and profit for each rental, with receipts attached and recurring costs that post themselves. At tax time, send your accountant a Schedule E-ready report in one tap.

One plan.
Every rental.

$7.99 a month per landlord account, for as many rentals as you add. Your first month is free, and you can cancel any time. Here is how NOHM gets paid, and what you pay NOHM.

First month free

Your plan

$7.99

A month per landlord account, for as many rentals as you add. Includes Financial Management on every rental: rent collection and tracking, ledgers and financial records, payment reminders and financial reporting, your Schedule E report included. NOHM Autopilot is optional, priced below.

Your tenant pays

$7

When they pay rent by bank (or you can cover it for them). About $5 of it is the bank processor’s cost. NOHM keeps about $2.

Applications

$0

Applying is free for your applicant. Background checks are coming soon.

NOHM Autopilot

$19.99

Optional, a month per rental, and it runs the rental for you. A property manager takes about 10% of the rent: $150 a month on a $1,500 home. Autopilot is $19.99, about 1.3%.

NOHM Walkthrough

$79

Only if you order one. A trained specialist does the condition report. Charged only when it’s in.

The plan is billed by the App Store or Google Play when you buy it in the app, or to your card when you buy it on the web. You never pay more than $7.99 a month for it ($95.88 a year), however many rentals you add. Rent goes straight to your connected payout account, and NOHM takes no percentage of rent. If a tenant’s bank payment is returned, the bank’s return fee (about $4) is taken from your next payout. NOHM shows you no ads, and we don’t spam you. If you book a pro for a repair or a NOHM walkthrough, you pay for that work, and you see the price before you book: Standard has no NOHM fee and is 48 hours or more after you book, Express is $30 for a pro today and NOHM NOW is $60 (60 for 60), plus the pro’s charges, which you approve first. We ask for a card on file to keep fake accounts out. It’s charged for work you book, and for NOHM Autopilot if you turn it on. If you start your plan on the web, it is also charged for the plan after your free month.

Questions.

What does NOHM cost?

$7.99 a month per landlord account, for as many rentals as you add. Your first month is free, and you can cancel any time. The rest, in short:

  • The plan: $7.99 a month, however many rentals. Billed by the App Store or Google Play when you buy it in the app, or to your card on the web.
  • Your tenant’s bank payment: $7 each time, paid by the tenant or covered by you.
  • Applications: free. Background checks are coming soon.
  • NOHM Walkthrough: $79, only if you order one.
  • NOHM Autopilot: $19.99 a month per rental, optional.
  • Repairs: you pay the pro you book, and you see the price before you book.

We ask for a card on file to keep fake accounts out. It’s charged for work you book, and for NOHM Autopilot if you turn it on. If you start your plan on the web, it is also charged for the plan after your free month.

How does NOHM make money?

From the plan. And when your tenant pays rent by bank, they pay a $7 fee (or you can cover it for them): about $5 is the bank processor’s cost, and NOHM keeps about $2. NOHM Autopilot and NOHM Walkthroughs are extras you choose. No spam, no ads.

Does NOHM take a cut of my rent?

No. Rent goes straight to your connected payout account. Your tenant pays the $7 bank payment fee, or you can cover it for them.

What does NOHM Autopilot actually do?

It answers tenant messages from your house notes, books repairs, reviews estimates, relists the unit after move-out and sends you a weekly summary. Emergencies always come straight to you. It’s optional: $19.99 a month per rental.

What is a NOHM Walkthrough?

A move-in or move-out condition report done in person by a trained local specialist. Every room is rated and photographed, both sides sign it, and it’s saved as a signed PDF. You can also do it yourself in the app.

Can I run a background check?

Not yet. Background checks are coming soon. Today you can send an application from the app and read it there. Applying is free for your applicant, and you approve or deny in the app.

Can I use my own lease?

Yes. Upload your lease as a PDF and you and your tenant e-sign it in the app. NOHM keeps a signing certificate with it.

How do deposits work at move-out?

Set the move-out date and NOHM tracks the deposit deadline. Itemize any deductions next to the move-in report, send the statement and mark the refund paid. Reminders go out before the deadline.

Can I see profit for each unit?

Yes. Money & Taxes shows income, costs and profit per rental, sorted into IRS Schedule E categories, with a year-end report you can email to your accountant.

Can I book a pro myself, without a tenant request?

Yes. Tap Request a Service, pick the unit and choose Standard, Express or NOHM NOW. Approve the estimate before work starts and follow your pro live.

What stays with the unit when a tenant moves out?

Everything. Repairs, condition reports and records are tied to the unit’s Home ID, so the next tenant and the next owner get the full history.

What if something goes wrong with a job?

Most things, like the quality of the work, are between you and your pro. NOHM steps in on no-shows, unsafe conduct and charges you didn’t approve. Learn more
